course_name_en: Women in the Process of Social Transformation

learning_outcomes.text: Students gain sensitivity and knowledge about various women's issues in society (discrimination against women, violence, etc.).
Students gain the ability to read social, political, and historical concepts through different and historically silenced groups.
Students become familiar with the basic concepts, methods, and discussions of women's studies, an interdisciplinary field.
Students learn to prepare an academic assignment.
Students learn the terminology of feminism.

syllabus_topics: Women's Studies as a Discipline: Making Visible
